scripts.show-report: cd webapp && npx playwright show-report playwright-report
scripts.seed-email-account: cd webapp && DATABASE_URL=$(grep DATABASE_URL .env.local | cut -d= -f2-) ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(grep ENCRYPTION_KEY .env.local | cut -d= -f2-) npx ts-node --compiler-options '{"module":"CommonJS"}' scripts/seed-test-email-account.ts
scripts.seed-lead-list: cd webapp && DATABASE_URL=$(grep DATABASE_URL .env.local | cut -d= -f2-) npx ts-node --compiler-options '{"module":"CommonJS"}' scripts/seed-test-lead-list.ts
scripts.seed-all: npm run seed-test-user && npm run seed-email-account && npm run seed-lead-list
